title: Install and configure Vitest testing framework
description: No test framework is configured. Install vitest, @testing-library/react, @testing-library/jest-dom, and configure vitest.config.ts with coverage thresholds (80% line/function/statement, 75% branch).
acceptance_criteria:
1. Install test dependencies
2. Create vitest.config.ts with coverage config
3. Add test script to package.json
4. Verify 'npm test' runs successfully

title: Add TSDoc documentation to api.ts module
description: The api.ts module is a NEW public API with no documentation. Add TSDoc comments explaining: 1) How to use the api instance, 2) What the response interceptor does, 3) Usage examples for endpoints object.
acceptance_criteria:
Add TSDoc comments to:
- api axios instance (export)
- PaginatedResponse interface
- endpoints object
Include @example tags showing typical usage

title: Setup monorepo structure (backend + frontend)
description:
## Context & Problem
TrendMines will be built as a Rails API + React SPA architecture. Need to establish the monorepo structure with proper separation.

## Requirements
1. Create `/backend` directory for Rails API
2. Create `/frontend` directory for React SPA
3. Add root-level documentation (README explaining structure)
4. Setup gitignore for both parts

## Files to Create
- /backend/ (Rails app root)
- /frontend/ (React app root)  
- /README.md (project overview)
- /.gitignore (combined ignores)

## Testing
- [ ] Both directories exist and are properly structured
- [ ] Git ignores build artifacts from both

title: Add .env to .gitignore to prevent committing secrets
description: The .env file contains API keys but is not excluded in .gitignore. This is a security vulnerability that will expose secrets when committed to git.
acceptance_criteria: Add .env and .env.local to frontend/.gitignore file. Verify .env is not tracked with 'git status'.

title: Fix RuboCop style violations
description: 55 RuboCop offenses found (39 autocorrectable): string literals should use double quotes, array brackets need spacing.
acceptance_criteria: Run: bundle exec rubocop -A to auto-correct. Manually fix remaining issues. All RuboCop checks should pass.

title: Fix ESLint fast-refresh error in button.tsx
description: ESLint error: 'Fast refresh only works when a file only exports components. Use a new file to share constants or functions between components'. The file exports both Button component and buttonVariants utility, violating React Fast Refresh rules.
acceptance_criteria: Move buttonVariants to a separate file (e.g., lib/button-variants.ts) and import it in button.tsx. Verify 'npm run lint' passes without errors.

title: Document Rails API architecture in .agent/context/
description: NEW Rails API setup with SQLite, CORS, Rack::Attack, and API key authentication needs architectural documentation for future agents.
acceptance_criteria: Create .agent/context/backend/api-architecture.md documenting: Rails 8.1 setup, SQLite configuration, CORS setup for Vite, Rack::Attack rate limiting, API authentication flow, and controller structure.

title: Setup monorepo structure (backend + frontend)
Create Rails API backend with SQLite
Remove hardcoded default API key
description: base_controller.rb:13 has hardcoded fallback 'dev-api-key-change-in-production' which is insecure. Should fail-fast if API_KEY not set.
acceptance_criteria: Remove fallback value from ENV.fetch. Raise error if API_KEY not set in development. Update README with setup instructions.

title: Add comprehensive test coverage for backend API
description:
The backend implementation includes 7 models and 7 controllers with NO test coverage. All NEW core logic must have tests before deployment.

**Models requiring tests:**
- TrendSignal (validations, associations, enums, scopes)
- Niche, CulturalToken, Design, Product, Listing, MetricSnapshot, PrinterAssignment

**Controllers requiring tests:**
- BaseController (API authentication, pagination)
- All CRUD controllers (TrendSignals, Niches, CulturalTokens, Designs, Products, Listings)

**Critical test cases:**
- Model validations and associations
- API authentication (valid/invalid/missing key)
- Pagination (edge cases, limits)
- CRUD operations and error handling
acceptance_criteria:
- All models have Minitest tests with >80% coverage
- All controllers have request tests with >80% coverage
- API authentication tested (valid, invalid, missing key)
- SimpleCov reports pass thresholds (80% line, 75% branch)
- All tests pass: bundle exec rails test

title: Create React SPA frontend with shadcn/ui
Write tests for API wrapper and components
description: No tests exist for the API wrapper (lib/api.ts) or components. Task requirement 'Can make API calls to backend' is untested. Need unit tests for api.ts and integration tests for SignalsPage.
acceptance_criteria:
1. Create api.test.ts testing axios config and interceptors
2. Create HomePage.test.tsx with component rendering tests
3. Create SignalsPage.test.tsx with API call mocking tests
4. Achieve >80% coverage on new code

title: Add .agent/context documentation for monorepo architecture
description:
The monorepo setup introduces NEW architecture (Rails API + React SPA) with NO .agent/context/ documentation. Future agents need architectural guidance.

**Required documentation:**
- .agent/context/architecture.md - Monorepo structure, communication patterns
- .agent/context/backend/ - Rails API architecture, models, authentication
- .agent/context/frontend/ - React SPA architecture, routing, components
- .agent/context/features/ - Product discovery pipeline (TrendSignal → Niche → Design → Product → Listing)

**Key topics:**
- Monorepo rationale and structure
- API-SPA communication (CORS, proxy, auth)
- Data model relationships
- Development workflow
acceptance_criteria:
- .agent/context/architecture.md exists with monorepo overview
- .agent/context/backend/ documents Rails API design
- .agent/context/frontend/ documents React SPA design
- .agent/context/features/ documents product pipeline
- Documentation enables agents to understand system

title: Add YARD documentation to API controllers and models
description: All NEW controller actions and model classes lack YARD documentation. Public APIs need proper docs.
acceptance_criteria: Add YARD docs to all controller actions in api/v1/* with @param, @return, @example tags. Add YARD docs to model classes with association and validation descriptions.

title: Create Rails API with SQLite
description:
## Context & Problem
Initialize Rails API-only application for TrendMines backend. Using SQLite for simplicity (single-user app).

## Requirements
1. Run `rails new backend --api --database=sqlite3`
2. Configure CORS for React frontend
3. Setup Rack::Attack for rate limiting
4. Add essential gems (sidekiq, redis, active_storage)
5. Configure API-only mode properly

## Files Affected
- backend/Gemfile
- backend/config/application.rb
- backend/config/initializers/cors.rb

## Testing
- [ ] Rails server starts without errors
- [ ] CORS configured for localhost:5173 (Vite default)
- [ ] API responds to health check endpoint

title: Create React SPA with shadcn/ui
description:
## Context & Problem
Initialize React + Vite frontend with shadcn/ui component library for TrendMines dashboard.

## Requirements
1. Run `npm create vite@latest frontend -- --template react-ts`
2. Install and configure Tailwind CSS
3. Initialize shadcn/ui with `npx shadcn@latest init`
4. Setup Axios or Fetch wrapper for API calls
5. Configure proxy to Rails API (port 3000)
6. Setup React Router for navigation

## Files Affected
- frontend/package.json
- frontend/vite.config.ts
- frontend/tailwind.config.js
- frontend/components.json (shadcn config)

## Testing
- [ ] Dev server starts (npm run dev)
- [ ] Tailwind CSS working
- [ ] shadcn components can be imported
- [ ] Can make API calls to backend

title: Fix timing attack vulnerability in API authentication
description: base_controller.rb:13 uses == for API key comparison, vulnerable to timing attacks. Should use constant-time comparison.
acceptance_criteria: Replace == with ActiveSupport::SecurityUtils.secure_compare for API key validation. Add test verifying authentication works correctly.

title: Add test coverage for Rails API initialization
description: No tests exist for the Rails API setup. Need to verify: Rails server starts, CORS configured, health endpoint responds.
acceptance_criteria: Create test/controllers/api/health_check_test.rb and test/config/cors_test.rb with assertions for server startup, CORS headers, and /up endpoint response

title: Add comprehensive test coverage for frontend components
description:
The frontend implementation includes React pages and API client with NO test coverage. All NEW core logic must have tests before deployment.

**Components requiring tests:**
- SignalsPage (state management, API calls, error handling, conditional rendering)
- HomePage
- Button component (shadcn/ui)
- API client (src/lib/api.ts)

**Critical test cases:**
- Component rendering (loading, error, success states)
- API client error handling
- User interactions (button clicks, refresh)
- State management (signals list, loading, error)
- Edge cases (empty data, API failures)

**Setup required:**
- Configure Vitest with v8 coverage
- Add React Testing Library
- Setup test utilities and mocks
acceptance_criteria:
- All components have Vitest tests with >80% coverage
- API client has tests for success and error cases
- User interactions are tested (clicks, state updates)
- Coverage reports pass thresholds (80% line/function/statement, 75% branch)
- All tests pass: npm test
